applicability_conditions: Kocks-Mecking (KM) model for average dislocation density evolution; the dislocation interaction term α_dis is equal to 0.5 for most metals.
latex: \left\{ \begin{array}{c} \frac{d \rho_{av}}{d \varepsilon} = d \rho_{WH} - k_{2} \rho_{av} \\ d \rho_{WH} = k_{1} \sqrt{\rho_{av}} \\ k_{2} = \frac{2 \theta_{0}}{\sigma_{s}^{(v)}} \\ k_{1} = \frac{\sigma_{s}^{(v)} k_{2}}{0.5 \mu b} \end{array} \right.
purpose: Kocks-Mecking (KM) model describing the evolution of the average dislocation density, where the net dislocation density change is expressed as work hardening (WH) contribution minus dynamic recovery (DRV), and the WH/DRV coefficients k_1 and k_2 are defined in terms of saturation stress, θ_0, μ and Burgers vector.

symbols.meaning: average dislocation density of the RVE
net change of the average dislocation density caused by work hardening (WH)
saturation stress, calibrated based on modified constitutive models in Section 3.1.2
dislocation interaction term (α_dis), equal to 0.5 for most metals
